def execute_great_aether_fire(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Ike's move first braces against damage, then strikes an area and heals the user based on damage dealt.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    assert is_valid_heal_target(actor,target)
    healed = clamp_healing_to_missing_health(target,configured_amount)
    health.apply_healing(target,healed)
    if specified: cleanse_selected_status_tags(target)
    emit_health_change_and_heal_visuals()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
